settings.eraseHint: Delete local messages and keys, then sign out
settings.eraseBody: This deletes all decrypted messages, cached media and this device's encryption keys, unlinks it from your account and signs out. Messages sent before now can no longer be read here.
settings.logoutBody: Your encryption keys and message history stay on this device so you can sign back in. To remove them, use "Erase this device" instead.

profile.title: Edit profile
profile.name: Display name
profile.visible: Your profile is visible to other Vero users. It is not end-to-end encrypted.

keys.title: This device
keys.note: The matching private key is stored in this device's secure keystore and never leaves it.

linked.title: Linked devices
linked.unlinkBody: Unlink "{{name}}"? New messages will no longer be encrypted for it and it will be signed out of encryption.
linked.note: Each device has its own key. Messages are encrypted separately for every linked device, so a new device can't read messages sent before it was linked.

audit.title: How Vero protects you
audit.e2eBody: Messages are encrypted on your device for each recipient device (X25519 + XChaCha20-Poly1305). Servers store ciphertext only.
audit.mediaBody: Every file gets its own random key before upload; Google Drive only stores ciphertext.
audit.keysBody: Private keys live in the platform keystore (Keychain / Keystore).
audit.aclBody: Row-level security and private realtime channels limit metadata to conversation members.
audit.pinBody: A device key change is rejected, and safety numbers let you rule out key substitution.
audit.fsBody: Messages use long-term device keys. A ratcheting protocol (Double Ratchet/MLS) is on the roadmap.
audit.metaBody: Servers can see who talks to whom and when, group names, and profile details.

verify.title: Safety number
verify.headline: Make sure it's really {{name}}.
verify.lede: Compare this number with the one on their phone, in person or over a trusted channel. If it matches, nobody — including Vero's servers — has swapped in their own keys between you.
verify.fingerprintHint: The same pattern appears on both devices.
verify.verifiedBody: You confirmed this number matches on both devices.
verify.changedBody: {{name}} (or you) added or replaced a device since you verified. Compare the new number again.
verify.unverifiedBody: Compare this number with the one on their phone, in person or over a trusted channel.
verify.demoBody: Safety numbers are computed from real device keys. Sign in with a real account to verify contacts.
verify.computeFailed: Could not compute the safety number.
verify.markedBody: If {{name}} adds or replaces a device, the number will change and Vero will show it as changed.
verify.howBody: The number is derived (iterated BLAKE2b) from the public identity keys of every active device on both accounts. Private keys never leave your devices.
